what_happened.line: The Finance Committee took no votes; it heard a briefing on how S&P rates the town's debt and on bonds that can be redeemed in 2020.
Staff reviewed the administration and unclassified budgets, including a proposed part-time HR director/assistant town manager that selectmen voted two to one not to support.
Part of the school increase was reallocated from town savings, leaving a smaller remaining gap in the school-town split.
The warrant articles were walked through, including a public access transfer article funded by a Comcast capital grant.
Next week's joint hearing was moved to a 6:15 start, with the hearing at 6:30 and the public access presentation first; the town manager will prepare the voting grid again.

why_it_matters: The debt rating affects what the town pays to borrow, and the budget and warrant items reviewed here, including a possible new HR position and the school-town split, shape the tax bill residents will be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
